command: set -u; : "${ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI:?}"; S=/work/g3c; mkdir -p "$S/runs" "$S/gates" || exit 2; SRC='s3://isolab-results-104186811093-us-east-2/runs/pfd-c-20261108/3eeef6a6-9565-415c-918c-b3f92801aafc//runs'; for f in C-t2-m2 C-t2-m3 C-t2-m4 C-t2-m5 C-t2-m6 C-t2-m2-p0 C-t2-m3-p0 C-t2-m4-p0 C-t2-m5-p0 C-t2-m6-p0 C-t3-m2 C-t3-m3 C-t3-m4 C-t3-m5 C-t3-m6 C-t3-m2-p0 C-t3-m3-p0 C-t3-m4-p0 C-t3-m5-p0; do aws s3 cp "$SRC/$f.jsonl" "$S/runs/$f.jsonl" --only-show-errors || exit 3; done; export RAYON_NUM_THREADS=${RAYON_NUM_THREADS:-12}; (cd "$S/runs" && sha256sum *.jsonl) > "$S/gates/g3-inputs.sha256"; sha256sum /usr/local/bin/pkm_tower_pilot /usr/local/bin/prime_fall_degree_tools > "$S/binary.sha256"; { echo "nproc: $(nproc)"; echo "rayon: $RAYON_NUM_THREADS"; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; } > "$S/host.txt"; /usr/local/bin/prime_fall_degree_tools gate3 "$S" /usr/local/bin/pkm_tower_pilot --max-n 20 --jobs 2 --budget 900 > "$S/gates/g3.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -q ', 0 disagreements' "$S/gates/g3.log" || { [ "$rc" = 0 ] && rc=1; }; echo "g3 exit $rc" > "$S/gates/g3.exit"; aws s3 cp "$S/binary.sha256" "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI/binary.sha256" --only-show-errors; aws s3 cp "$S/host.txt" "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI/host.txt" --only-show-errors; aws s3 sync "$S/gates" "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI/gates" --only-show-errors; exit $rc
